nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: Battery power sign convention
nodes.rationale: There is no universal convention across HA integrations for whether a positive battery power reading means charging or discharging; the dashboard defaults to positive=charging, exposes a Settings -> Energy toggle to invert it, and self-diagnoses a likely-wrong convention by sampling whether the derived consumption comes out negative more often than not over a rolling window, surfacing a named verdict with a one-tap invert rather than ever showing a bare negative consumption number.

nodes.label: Empty state case (a): no rooms discovered at all
nodes.rationale: Widened from the old check (literally zero areas in the registry) to the actually-common cause: areas exist but entities were never assigned to one. Shows a 'Go to Areas' card regardless of why it's empty.

nodes.label: Empty state case (b): configured energy entity doesn't exist
nodes.rationale: A configured energy role pointing at an entity ID that no longer exists names the missing ID directly and links to the exact Settings -> Energy row, instead of quietly rendering an unexplained ring full of dashes. Reproducible with ?demo&scenario=missing.

nodes.label: Derived house consumption formula
nodes.rationale: consumption = production + gridImport - gridExport + batteryDischarge - batteryCharge. Only runs when production/gridImport/gridExport all resolve; otherwise shows an honest '-' rather than a partial derivation. An explicit consumption sensor always wins over the derivation.
